selected_skill.selection_reason: High-star project-management skill with no private-account dependency and a workflow that maps directly to backlog triage, story estimation, capacity planning, sprint goal setting, and cutline decisions.

safe_use_screening.notes: Excluded Jira, Trello, Linear, Things, and transcript-analysis candidates because they depend on external workspaces, private credentials, or higher-sensitivity user data.

real_data_design.normalization_strategy: Use real issue titles and public issue links as the semantic backbone, then add local sprint-only fields such as owner role, milestone date, readiness, blockers, dependencies, and must-ship flags inside the in-container planning service.
real_data_design.determinism: All public-source-derived inputs are copied into task files or hidden service data so the verifier can recompute the plan without network calls.

services: local planning service on 127.0.0.1:8137 with paginated item summaries and item detail endpoints
environment_design.with_without_control: The runtime pair differs only by whether environment/skills is present in the build context. Dockerfile copies the full environment tree and conditionally installs skills if the directory exists.

goals: State the business deliverable, authoritative source rule, and hard prohibitions.
Expose the existence of the live planning service without spelling out the entire diagnostic workflow.
Make the solver discover that backlog_export is stale and incomplete.
hidden_workflow_pressure: The list endpoint is paginated and incomplete without following all pages.
The detail endpoint carries ready, blocked, dependency, must-ship, and review-bandwidth facts.
The verifier checks for service access and pagination before it runs its own queries.

main_tests: required output files exist and parse
triage rows exactly match the live backlog facts and selected/rejected decisions
committed item order follows the policy sort and capacity constraints
deferred items cover all non-selected non-closed items with the right rejection reasons
manager update contains the required business summary facts
guardrails: solver must use the live planning service before verifier traffic begins
solver must follow pagination through every page and fetch detail records
input files and hidden service code/data hashes must remain unchanged
service must still be healthy at verifier end
a live-only item absent from backlog_export must still appear in the output
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill failures should be action-level misses such as relying on the stale export, skipping a page, skipping detail fetches, or misapplying capacity/dependency logic.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every cloud trial must start from a fresh isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.oracle_rule: Do not finalize README until oracle and comparison trials are available.
experiment_protocol.comparison_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills presence in the runtime copy.
